title: A sponsor principal leaves
summary: Apply the partner agreement, check key-person terms with lenders and investors, and reassign duties.

situation.trigger: A principal resigns, becomes unable to work or dies.

outlineSteps: Confirm the departure terms and the effective date
Read the partner agreement's departure and buyout terms
Check key-person clauses in loans, fund documents and JV agreements
List each role, signing authority and account the principal held
Reassign duties and update bank signers and system access
Notify lenders, partners and investors as their documents require
Update entity filings where the principal was named
Settle the departing principal's ownership and promote
Record the changes in the firm file
